body:
> Filed 2026-08-28 after the operator moved the default `claude` profile to Sonnet 5 to protect a subscription. Model and effort are per-card decisions today only by hand; this makes them part of the system without putting a judgment call in the dispatcher.

## Why

Three facts about this board on 2026-08-28:

- Every worker ran on Opus 5 at Claude Code's default effort (`xhigh`), because `board.json` pinned `model: claude-opus-5` and the launch arrays pass no `--effort` at all. Effort moves spend more than tier does on this model family.
- The only way to pass `--effort` today is to copy the whole shipped launch array into `board.json` and edit it — which this board now does, and which **freezes** the array against future defaults (`deepMerge`, `src/board.js:269-274`, replaces an array wholesale; #143's `Bash(hkb dispatch*)` deny reached this board only because the copy was taken after it merged).
- A retry re-runs the exact launch that just failed: attempt 2 gets the same model as attempt 1. Nothing on the board makes a second try smarter than the first.

Most decomposed cards are bounded, test-verified, single-module work — the Sonnet-shaped kind. A few are not. The board should express that per card at planning time, and escalate on its own when the cheap guess was wrong.

## What

**A — `effort` is a profile field, not a launch edit.** `effort: "medium"` on a profile expands to `--effort <level>` through a new `{effort_args}` token in `expandLaunch` (`src/dispatch.js`), exactly as `{model_args}` does for `model`; the shipped launch arrays (`src/board.js`) carry the token. `kb.effort` on a card wins over the profile, like `kb.model`. Then delete this board's two `launch` overrides and go back to the shipped arrays — `hkb doctor` gains a line that says when a board's `launch` override is byte-identical to the default minus a flag the profile could express (*"launch override in board.json only adds `--effort`; set `effort` on the profile and drop it"*).

**B — a retry climbs a ladder.** `model_ladder: ["claude-sonnet-5", "claude-opus-5"]` on a profile; attempt `k` launches on rung `min(k, len) - 1`. Pure function `modelForAttempt(task, profile, k)` in `src/model.js`: `kb.model` pins every attempt (a card that must start high stays high); no ladder → today's behaviour. The attempt row records `model` at spawn so `hkb show` and the run comment say which rung ran. One line in `spawnWorker`.

**C — the planners suggest.** `/kanban:decompose`'s child table (`skills/kanban/SKILL.md`, *"| child | title | blocked by | paths | agent | priority |"*) gains a `model` column and `/kanban:specify` a `model` field, with the rubric in the skill text: one module + a test that decides + no design freedom → the profile's first rung; cross-module, concurrency, protocol semantics, anything a reviewer cannot tick from a checklist → pin `claude-opus-5`. `hkb create --model` already carries it. Coordinate with #117, which reopens the same recipe.

Out of scope here, filed where the data lives: a `by_model` table in `hkb stats` (#155 — needs `model_usage` on the row) and the operator's "read it, adjust the ladder" routine (#149).

## Constraints

- The dispatcher chooses by arithmetic on `k`, never by reading the card's text. No LLM in the tick (ADR-004).
- `kb.model` and `kb.effort` are the card's word and beat both the ladder and the profile.
- Backend-neutral: the token expands to nothing on a harness whose profile sets no `effort`; Copilot/Codex launches are untouched.

## Done when

- `hkb init` boards get `{effort_args}` in every Claude launch array and `effort: "medium"` on `claude`; `hkb dispatch --dry-run` shows `--effort medium` with no `launch` override in `board.json`.
- A card whose attempt 1 ended `protocol_violation` on `claude-sonnet-5` is relaunched on `claude-opus-5`; `hkb show` names both rungs.
- A card with `kb.model` set runs that model on every attempt.
- The decompose/specify sections carry the `model` column/field and the rubric; `references/protocol.md`'s example stays consistent.
- `test/model.test.js` (ladder, pin, no-ladder), `test/dispatch.test.js` (relaunch on rung 2, `{effort_args}` expansion), `test/skill.test.js`; `npm run lint && npm test` green; `npm run smoke` (board defaults are read from the package).
- The pinned and the actual model are visible on the board: `hkb list` marks a card only when `kb.model` pins one (e.g. `·opus-5` after the priority), `hkb show` prints `model` per attempt row, `hkb doctor` prints each profile's `model` / `effort` / ladder on its profile line, and the serve drawer renders `kb.model` and the attempt's model. `--json` carries `kb.model` (already) and `attempts[].model`.
title: Model and effort are the board's decision: an effort field, a retry ladder, and a model column at decompose time
